environment.scope: Local source, canonical payload and isolated installed fixtures; four live Slack tests intentionally deselected.

observations.normal_view_workflow: Source and actual sealed installed code-change -> impact -> attributed review -> release rebinding -> sync-views -> validate; exercised by the full suite.
observations.preservation: Exact original-family, restrictive-umask recovery, source reread drift and report-only protections included.
observations.metadata_only_during_run: Root and Knowledge guide prose clarified review-store ownership; semantic re-review uses s08-document-review-evidence-r2.json. No product runtime or test code changed during the canonical run.

repair_history.structural_store: Canonical publication SOURCE_DRIFT reproduced in required directories; configured output roles separated from directory inputs; explicit named files and ignored unknown siblings remain bound.
repair_history.red: Two required-directory reproductions failed at the publication guard. Two initial tree fixtures lacked child entries and failed their negative assertion; corrected fixtures now assert structural classification.
repair_history.focused_closure: Five focused cases passed before the final 1880-test canonical pass.
repair_history.previous_passes: 1875-test result and earlier passes remain historical evidence, not substituted for this run.

limits: Independent reviews, actual guide views and report-only final gardening are separate completion gates.
